I’ll read the continuation note and the updated overview and progress files, then work through TND-D-B03 and record the findings and handoff guidance in the investigation folders.

The 10 November update confirms that this pass is limited to one joint lattice or modular reorganization of the full formula, including the boundary term. I’ll use that scope and preserve the earlier results and review qualifications. The recorder has also found this chat’s local source; I’m registering it in the direct investigation’s history folder.

I’m testing simultaneous Poisson inversion of the two lattice factors. It preserves the full formula, but exposes a specific difficulty: each transformed factor is a theta sum minus its continuum contribution. I’ll check whether that cancellation can be controlled at the collision’s shrinking scale, while retaining the boundary term and comparing against the original lattice formula.

The comparison now gives a precise limitation. For the same retained indices and the same absolute-tail method, the inverted lattice has an error bound at least as large as the original lattice’s bound. A fixed dual cutoff also loses the decay needed for the full positive-time integral. This limits the tested truncation method; it leaves open an estimate that keeps the signed remainder and boundary term together.

The local check supports the written comparison. On the original radial domain, one original-lattice term already gives the stated coarse relative accuracy; achieving fixed relative accuracy with the literal dual prefix requires a cutoff growing roughly as the radius squared. I’m recording this as a limitation of that specific method. The joint signed estimate remains open, so E09/E10 will stay unissued, with continuation guidance for a new strategy.

The research note, continuation guidance, and live status files now agree on the scoped stop and the remaining joint-cancellation gap. The local checks passed, and the inherited mathematical sources are unchanged. I’m refreshing the chat archive and arranging capture of the final reply.

Completed the bounded B03 pass using the updated overview and progress files.

The result is a **scoped stop**: simultaneous modular inversion preserves the full formula, but its tested independent-tail bounds are no better than the original lattice bounds. The joint signed estimate remains open; **E09/E10 remain unissued**. Results have proof-author local checking.
